name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
tagline: Guadalupe Mountains — visitor center and short desert foothill walks.

practical.transit_note: Remote on US-62/180; no gas in park.
practical.energy_note: Heat and wind; peak hikes are hard.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → short foothill path → overlook if any
practical.season_note: Summer very hot; winter can be icy on peaks.
